description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

As a Workforce Planning Analyst supporting Backoffice operations, you'll turn workload trends into reliable forecasts, staffing analyses, and practical recommendations that help teams meet service commitments efficiently. In your first year, you'll strengthen capacity visibility, flag emerging workload or coverage risks early, and support data-informed decisions with Operations, Workforce Management, and Finance.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You'll analyze back-office workload volumes, seasonal trends, and incoming work to prepare and update short- and medium-term forecasts.
  • You'll maintain staffing and capacity models using processing times, productivity assumptions, shrinkage, paid time off, and available coverage.
  • You'll monitor throughput, backlog aging, utilization, service-level results, and forecast-to-actual variances to identify risks and opportunities.
  • You'll partner withOperations and Workforce Management to review staffing needs, queue coverage, and practical schedule or resource adjustments.
  • You'll build and maintain reports, scorecards, and dashboards that communicate workforce performance clearly to Operations, Finance, and other stakeholders.
  • You'll support scenario analyses for changing demand, hiring, overtime, and productivity improvements, documenting assumptions and trade-offs.
  • You'll help improve workforce data quality, reporting consistency, and planning processes, proactively suggesting ways to reduce manual work.
  • You'll explore AI tools thoughtfully to streamline analysis and reporting while checking outputs for accuracy, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
  • You'll partner Operations to develop and maintain capacity models, scheduling templates, and workload forecasts that align staffing resources with operational demand and service-level targets.
  • You'll collaborate with Operations to continuously refine forecasting assumptions, optimize scheduling strategies, and identify opportunities to improve productivity, resource utilization, and workforce efficiency.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You're a detail-oriented, curious analyst who connects operational data to the decisions teams make every day. You spot emerging capacity risks, communicate trade-offs clearly, and work collaboratively to improve service, productivity, and staffing efficiency.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • You'll have 3+ years of experience in workforce management, capacity planning, forecasting, operations analytics, or a closely related function.
  • You'll have a bachelor's degree in business, operations, analytics, mathematics, finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • You've used operational data to maintain forecasts or staffing models, evaluate trends, and explain deviations between expected and actual performance.
  • You bring strong spreadsheet modeling skills and experience with workforce management tools or comparable planning and reporting systems.
  • You understand back-office measures such as case volumes, processing times, throughput, backlog aging, utilization, and service-level targets.
  • You communicate findings clearly, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with operational stakeholders under general guidance.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting transactional Backoffice operations, financial services, or other volume-driven, service-level-focused teams.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Domo, or similar analytics and dashboard tools.
  • Exposure to scenario planning, queue-level capacity analysis, cross-training strategies, or workforce process improvement.
  • You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your productivity while reviewing results for accuracy and responsible use.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Working at Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

Mexico Benefits:

Major Medical Insurance

Savings Fund

Life Insurance

Internet and Electricity Allowance

This is a summary of select benefits and does not represent the full benefits package. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE  #LI-VR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

 

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

 

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).
